name: titles
task: (b) listing title -> brand / line / size class / inches / version
recordedFrom: Shopify /products.json pages read 2026-10-30 06:57 UTC through the PoliteFetcher (canadaluggagedepot p1+p13, delsey-ca p1); deterministic sample by sha1(handle), quotas 60 luggage / 28 bags / 12 accessories
labelledBy: Claude Code (v4 overnight review), by hand from the title text only; brand also checked against the store vendor field

labelRules.brand: canonical brand name; compared case- and punctuation-insensitively
labelRules.sizeClass: one of underseat carry_on medium large extra_large set backpack duffel garment tote briefcase accessory; the store own size word wins over inches; null when the title states no size
labelRules.inches: integer part of a stated size in inches, 14-34; null if none
labelRules.version: version number of the product line (2.0, 3.0, 2, V2 -> 2); null if none
labelRules.line: product family words, lower case, split on non-alphanumerics except .; excludes brand, size, type, colour, material, feature words; null = not scored (accessories); [] = the title names no family
